article.headline: Massive Multi-State Storm System Triggers Severe Alerts Across Eastern Australia
article.summary: The Bureau of Meteorology has issued severe thunderstorm warnings for southern Queensland, western NSW, the ACT, and eastern Victoria.
article.body:
Wind gusts reaching 100km/h were recorded in the central west of New South Wales around midday on Sunday as a broad, unusually large storm system swept across the region. The event follows intense weather conditions that saw the Sunshine Coast record 289mm of rain this month, more than triple the October average of 90mm, according to the Bureau of Meteorology.

This multi-state system carries significant risks, including flash flooding, power outages, large hail, and damaging winds. The volatile conditions result from a cold front pushing against warm, humid air along the eastern seaboard, finally displacing a high-pressure system that had been blocking weather fronts for 10 days. Beyond property damage, Victorian authorities have issued a high-risk warning for epidemic thunderstorm asthma, specifically for the East Gippsland region.

The Bureau of Meteorology notes that a continuous line of storms currently extends from the Snowy Mountains to the Queensland border. Meteorologist David Crock stated that while conditions will persist through Sunday evening, Monday marks the final major phase of this system, which should provide relief for residents in south-east Queensland who have experienced recent weather whiplash. The SES has already managed hundreds of callouts, including 124 requests for assistance in a single night following heavy rain on the Sunshine Coast.

As the cold front advances, residents in central and eastern Victoria, as well as northern NSW, should expect the weather to intensify further. Airlines have begun preparing for potential travel disruptions caused by the hazardous conditions.

article.headline: Emil Forsberg seals 2-0 win as New York Red Bulls topple Miami
article.summary: The New York Red Bulls ended Inter Miami's three-match winning streak with a 2-0 victory at Red Bull Arena on Saturday.
article.body: The New York Red Bulls snapped Inter Miami’s three-match winning streak on Saturday night, securing a 2-0 victory at Red Bull Arena. The hosts grabbed an early advantage just seven minutes into the contest when a defensive lapse saw Casemiro inadvertently deflect a Cade Cowell cross into his own net. Emil Forsberg later cemented the win for New York with a clinical right-footed strike from the center of the box into the high center of the goal, following an assist from Cameron Harper.  This result marks a significant setback for Cristian “Kily” González’s side, which struggled to find a breakthrough despite commanding 62.5% of the possession. While Inter Miami generated several opportunities, including a strike that hit the bar from Telasco Segovia and a blocked effort from Lionel Messi, they were limited to only two shots on target throughout the match.  Lionel Messi began the game on the bench following a trip to Spain to accept the Princess of Asturias Award for Sports. Introduced in the 56th minute, the Argentine icon attempted to spark a comeback, but the defeat ended his remarkable run of 13 consecutive matches with either a goal or an assist. The tactical decision to start Messi as a substitute was pre-planned to manage his physical condition ahead of upcoming fixtures.  With this defeat, Inter Miami now looks to regroup quickly. The team faces their next challenge on Wednesday, as they attempt to recover from the loss and return to their prior winning form.

article.headline: Wheelchair participants lead 22,000 runners as Dublin Marathon kicks off today
article.summary: The 45th Irish Life Dublin Marathon began this morning with waves of participants departing from Leeson Street between 8:40am and 9:45am.
article.body:
The massive field of 22,000 runners began their journey on the 26.2 mile course following an opening medal presentation at the Leeson Street start line. Wheelchair participants were the first to surge onto the route at 8:40am, followed closely by elite athletes at 8:45am and several subsequent waves of runners concluding their departures by 9:45am.

This event creates significant disruption throughout the capital as road closures and diversions are in place across the city centre and suburban areas. Public transport users are advised to plan for service changes, including a notable suspension of Dart services between Grand Canal Dock and Bray due to infrastructure works. The marathon route remains open for a total of seven hours for all participants to reach the finish line.

According to RTE, the course travels through the historic Liberties, enters Phoenix Park at the 6km mark, and proceeds through Chapelizod, Inchicore, and Terenure. The final 10km segment features a challenging hilly path on Milltown Road and Clonskeagh, followed by a downhill stretch along Fosters Avenue before reaching the finish at Pepper Cannister Church. Organisers report that the event serves as a major charitable effort, with over €5 million already raised for various causes.

Participants and spectators are focused on the finish line at Pepper Cannister Church, where the first wheelchair competitors are expected to arrive shortly after 10:30am. The entire course will be cleared seven hours after the start as local authorities manage the ongoing impact on Dublin’s traffic and public transport networks.

article.headline: Prince William reveals he tried to remove Travis Kelce from royal selfie
article.summary: Prince William admitted on The Graham Norton Show that he attempted to exclude Travis Kelce from a 2024 photograph taken with Taylor Swift and his children.
article.body:
Prince William revealed his comedic struggle during a surprise appearance on the Oct. 23 episode of The Graham Norton Show. While reflecting on his family's attendance at the first night of Taylor Swift’s eight-night London residency at Wembley Stadium, the 44-year-old Prince of Wales confessed he kept trying to move the Kansas City Chiefs tight end out of the frame. William intended for the photo to feature only himself, the singer, and his two eldest children, Prince George and Princess Charlotte. “Travis kept coming back in, and I couldn't work out why he kept coming back in!” the Prince joked to the host.

This incident is notable because the photograph, which features a smiling Kelce with his hand on the Prince's back, eventually served as the singer’s public confirmation of her relationship with the NFL star on Instagram. William admitted that he did not grasp the weight of the moment at the time, noting that he only recently came to appreciate its significance. He did not realize he was witnessing the start of a major chapter in the couple's romance.

Despite the initial confusion during the photo session, the meeting between the royal and the athlete left a lasting impression. Following their encounter in June 2024, Prince William made a guest appearance on the “New Heights” podcast hosted by Travis and his brother Jason. During that July appearance, Travis reflected on the meeting, describing it as one of the coolest moments of his life. William also appeared to hold no hard feelings, laughing along with the lengthy, formal introduction provided by Jason Kelce before their interview began.

article.body: Shaheen Afridi reached a milestone of 150 ODI wickets as he dismissed England opener Tom Banton during the clash in Lahore. Banton attempted an early drive off a delivery from Shaheen, only to find Arafat Minhas at cover, handing Pakistan a crucial early breakthrough in the tri-series contest. This match represents a critical juncture for England, which is attempting to rebound from a crushing loss to Sri Lanka last Thursday. The team’s recent form includes a high-scoring 430-run effort where Harry Brook scored a double-century, yet the side ultimately failed to defend that total, raising significant concerns for the squad less than a year before the World Cup. For England, a third consecutive defeat in this format would intensify pressure on the team to find a complete performance. Pakistan enters the match holding a psychological advantage after winning the previous meeting between the two sides by 87 runs. In that encounter, England was bowled out for just 215, struggling against Arafat Minhas who claimed six wickets. A victory for Pakistan at their Lahore headquarters would secure their place in the tournament final with a match still to play. news.og_desc: India's para-athletes produced a spectacular finish to their campaign at the Asian Para Games, registering their best-ever medal haul of 114 medals, including 30 gold, after a record-breaking final-day flourish in Aichi-Nagoya on Friday.

news.title: Thulasimathi Murugesan, Avani Lekhara, Manish Narwal reflect on medal wins, India's Asian Para Games 2026 success
news.og_title: Thulasimathi Murugesan, Avani Lekhara, Manish Narwal reflect on medal wins, India's Asian Para Games 2026 success
news.og_desc: Indian para-athletes, including para-badminton player Thulasimathi Murugesan, shooter Avani Lekhara and para powerlifter Ashok Kumar Malik, expressed happiness over their performances at the Asian Para Games 2026 in Japan as they received a rousing welcome at the Delhi airport following the continental event. India concluded its campaign at the Asian Para Games 2026 with a record haul of 114 medals, including 30 gold, 35 silver and 49 bronze, as the country's para-athletes delivered world-record performances, historic victories and podium sweeps across multiple disciplines. Speaking to ANI after her return, para-badminton player Thulasimathi Murugesan, who won silver in women's singles SU5 and mixed doubles SL3-SU5 alongside Nitesh Kumar, and gold in women's doubles SL3-SU5 with Manasi Joshi, expressed happiness at reaching the finals in all three events despite the challenge of balancing her sporting career with veterinary medicine studies. I'm very happy that I could make it to three finals. I was able to play three finals in all three events. I'm also doing veterinary medicine. So, training was so hectic and so hard, balancing both veterinary and also playing para badminton. And also it's a career-important tournament for all the athletes. Finally, I made it. So I was just thinking on the last day about one match at a time because I had three matches in a day, she said. Murugesan expressed happiness over India's fourth-place finish with 114 medals and dedicated her medal to her father. We have made an historic medal of 114 and India in the medal tally. India is in fourth position now. We are very happy to know this, and I would like to dedicate this medal to my father, she added. Para powerlifter Ashok Kumar Malik, who won silver in the men's 65kg category, said his performance had improved from the bronze medal he won at the previous edition. He credited his support system and said he would now prepare for the 2028 Olympics. Last time I won a bronze medal; this time I have won a silver medal. I have received support from my team, coach, family, village, and the Government of India. Going forward, I will prepare for the 2028 Olympics, he told ANI. Para table tennis player Baby Sahana Ravi, who won bronze in women's singles Class 9, described the medal as a significant milestone in her career, having competed at the Asian Para Games for the second time. This being my second Asian Games and this is my first Asian Games medal, I feel very happy. I feel very proud as this is the first Asian Games medal for the standing category. So, I feel proud and more responsible because now I have to prove myself in the other upcoming prestigious events like the World Championship and Olympics. Looking forward to it, she said. Meanwhile, her fellow para table tennis player, Prachi Pandey, who secured bronze in women's singles Class 6, thanked her coaches and family for their support, particularly her coach Amit. I would like to thank my coaches, and I was trained at SAI Gandhi Nagar. So, all the staff, they all supported me in this journey and I feel very happy and my family, they are also very happy. I dedicate my medal to my coaches and my family. My coach is Amit sir; he supported me everywhere. I'm so thankful for him, she said. Para shooter Avani Lekhara, who won silver in the women's 10m air rifle standing SH1 event, thanked those who welcomed the contingent and said the athletes had improved on their previous performance. I am so happy and so grateful to everyone who has come here for our team and who are celebrating our success. Thank you so much. It's a good winning streak. It's better than last time, and we all gave our 100%, and we all did very well. I think if we keep getting this support and encouragement, we will do better each and every year next time, she said. Bronze medallist Shrishti Arora, who competed in the women's 10m air pistol SH1 event, described her debut at the Asian Para Games as a valuable learning experience and said her next target is the Los Angeles 2028 Paralympic Games. It feels really good that we played for our country, brought home a medal, and that our whole country is here to welcome us. It was a great experience, a great learning experience since it was my first Asian Para Games. So, it was a great learning experience. The target is definitely the LA 2028 Paralympic Games, and there are ups and downs, but you have to learn from it, she said. Silver medallist Manish Narwal, who won a medal in the men's 10m air pistol SH1 event, expressed confidence that India's sporting achievements would continue to grow in the coming years. India is no longer the old India; this is a new India, and it's moving forward, gaining speed rapidly. So in the next few years, these numbers-like the 114 medals you just mentioned-will definitely double or even triple, he said. Notably, with the 114 medals, India surpassed its previous edition's medal tally of 108, comprising 27 gold, 32 silver and 49 bronze medals. The country had initially won 111 medals at the last edition, but three were subsequently stripped following doping charges against Neeraj Yadav and Parveen. India's performance at Aichi-Nagoya exceeded expectations, particularly as the contingent was significantly smaller than the one that competed in the previous edition. A total of 168 para-athletes represented India at the 2026 Games, compared to 309 athletes at Hangzhou. (ANI)
